title: Unit – 5 : Session – 10 : SLO – 1  |  Real-Time Interaction Through Trigger Functions
sections: 1. Trigger function — a callback function registered to a widget (or event) that is automatically invoked when the associated event fires, e.g. a button's command function.
2. When they execute — at the moment the triggering event occurs (button click, key press, timer), dispatched by the event loop in real time, not at a fixed point in the program's sequence.
